messages:
Tara: kicking off tenant-scoped rollout for chart release v2.14.0 tonight during change window 22:00-02:00 PST. plan: pin chart, stagger tenants in groups of ~20, backfill missing values from defaults, and run canaries per-group. will use rolling update with maxUnavailable=10%.

Josh: SGTM. who owns the values backfill script? do we apply via helm upgrade --reuse-values or a merge job?

Carla: I wrote a small backfill job. it reads tenant values from s3, merges with chart defaults, writes a per-tenant values.yaml and does `helm upgrade --install --wait --timeout 5m -f tenant-values.yaml --set image.tag=2.14.0`. can paste snippet below.

Carla: ```bash
# backfill + deploy (simplified)
python tools/backfill_and_deploy.py --tenant $TENANT --chart infra/tenant-chart --tag 2.14.0 --s3-prefix s3://redwood-tenant-values
# fallback: helm upgrade --reuse-values if you want to keep manual overrides
``` 

Michael: thanks. one question: for legacy tenants that have missing keys, do we add the new feature flags as false default or preserve nulls? I'd prefer explicit defaults to avoid runtime panics.

Carla: set defaults in chart `values.yaml`, backfill sets explicit keys. default policy = explicit. safer.

SRE-Oncall: sounding good. propose canary sizing: start with 5 tenants (group A), monitor 15m for 5xx rate, p50/p95 latency, and error budget burn. if healthy, bump to 20 tenants (group B), then 50.

Tara: yes. gates: 5xx < 0.5% and latency regression < +15% p95. if any gate fails -> automatic pause + manual triage. deploy-bot will open a rollback runbook if needed.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed for chart v2.14.0: image digest verified, values schema validation OK, infra quotas OK. starting canary for group A now.

deploy-bot: canary start logs -> https://logs.redwood.internal/canary/1937654321

Josh: adding release-notes entry and ops ticket: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OPS-3141

Carla: dropping backfill job id if anyone needs to re-run: backfill-20260320-01

deploy-bot: group A canary metrics after 10m: 5xx=0.12%, p95 latency +3%, CPU stable. passing gates.

Michael: the metrics look clean for A. go to group B when ready.

deploy-bot: moving to group B (20 tenants). initiating rolling upgrades with maxUnavailable=10%.

deploy-bot: ALERT: group B tenant `acct-482` showing elevated 5xx spike (1.8%) and repeated DB session errors.

SRE-Oncall: pausing group B rollout. manual rollback for acct-482 initiated? prefer pinning that tenant back to v2.13.9 while we investigate.

Tara: agree. don't rollback the whole release; pin that tenant and continue with other tenants after we confirm isolation. create quick rollback command for that tenant.

Carla: rollback cmd for a single tenant is:

Carla: ```bash
helm upgrade --install acct-482 infra/tenant-chart -f tenant-values-acct-482.yaml --set image.tag=2.13.9 --wait --timeout 3m
``` 

deploy-bot: rollback for acct-482 completed. confirm: 5xx back to 0.05% and p95 restored.

Michael: good. capture heap traces and DB logs for acct-482 and annotate OPS-3141. looks like a tenant-specific config key caused a NPE in the adapter.

Carla: found the missing key in the tenant values; backfill script did not encounter it because the tenant had a legacy override. patching the backfill to force-add missing keys and re-run for legacy tenants.

Tara: action items: 1) patch backfill script and re-run for legacy group (Carla). 2) add post-rollout verify step to run small smoke tests per tenant (Josh). 3) add note to release notes for devs to check feature flag defaulting (Tara).

Josh: I'll add the smoke test harness: smoke-test --tenant $TENANT --check endpoints, auth, sample-gen.

deploy-bot: resuming rollout: group B skipped acct-482 (pinned). continuing with remaining tenants. ETA for completion ~1h.

SRE-Oncall: adding monitoring alert to catch regression across tenants: alert if 5xx > 0.7% for >2m for any tenant group.

Tara: thanks team. postmortem if anything else comes up. please update OPS-3141 with timelines and the backfill run id when done. :thumbsup:

Carla: ran backfill for legacy batch at 2026-03-20T22:10Z: backfill-run=backfill-20260320-02. re-deployed 12 tenants from legacy pool.

deploy-bot: final summary: rollout partially progressed: 320/341 tenants upgraded, 1 tenant pinned/rolled back (acct-482). change window still open, continuing cleanup and post-rollout verifications.

Tara: closing loop: update release-notes with the pinned tenant note and include mitigation steps. thanks everyone.
